Welcome to Mini Cup!
Join our Communications server Linked Below To Vote on New Game Features and Participate in Huge Tournaments!





- 📶FAST CONNECTION REQUIRED -
- Please (👍) Like! -

Is it soccer? Is it football? 
Play as your favorite national teams from around the world in the miniaturized version of the worlds biggest competition!

Tips: 
- The ball will go in the direction you are facing! Use shift-lock to hit the ball in the opposite direction quickly!
- Angle the ball towards the net to score.
- Organize your team and have a goal keeper.
- Don't chase the ball! Be open and anticipate where it will go next.
- Pass to your teammates!


Keywords: Soccer, Football, Minicup, Mini Cup, MPS, TPS, Futbol, Touch Football, Touch Soccer, Messi, Ronaldo, Manchester.
